# Ayush Agarwal

> Ayush Agarwal is a full-stack engineer based in Bangalore, India, working on distributed systems at global scale and shipping side projects with AI-native workflows. Main stack: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and prompt engineering.

## Open source

- [ASOpulse](https://github.com/ayushhagarwal/asopulse): A self-hosted App Store keyword workspace for tracking daily rankings and researching keywords
- [StaySpan](https://github.com/ayushhagarwal/stayspan): A local-first Chrome extension that turns hotel confirmation pages into one private stay timeline
- [Markdown Lens](https://markdownlens.ayushdev.com/): A privacy-first online Markdown editor and viewer with GitHub-style previews

## Apps

- [XML Lens](https://xmllens.ayushdev.com/): XSD viewer, XML to Markdown converter, and XML workspace for Mac
- [Buddha Daily](https://buddhadaily.ayushdev.com/): One short Buddhist teaching each day for iPhone and iPad
- [DiveAtlas](https://diveatlas.ayushdev.com/): Scuba dive logbook for iPhone and iPad
- [GarageLog](https://garagelog.ayushdev.com/): Car maintenance tracker for iPhone and iPad
- [OfficeComply](https://office-comply.ayushdev.com/): Private RTO and hybrid office attendance tracker for iPhone
- [SkinRitual](https://skin-ritual.ayushdev.com/): Skincare routine planner and tracker for iPhone
- [Fiberly](https://fiberly.ayushdev.com/): Daily fiber tracker for iPhone and iPad
- [Bonely](https://bonely.app/): Calcium tracker for iPhone
